candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement checking msg.sender == Owner so anyone can drain the contract's balance.
Invert the ownership check so the function only succeeds for non-owner callers.
Change the transfer amount from the full contract balance to exactly 1 wei.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw() succeeds without sending any funds.
Replace the require guard with an always-failing assertion so withdraw() always reverts.
Delete the owner check require statement so anyone can execute Command.
Change the require to its negation so Command only works for non-owners.
Send the contract's entire balance with the call instead of only msg.value.
Delete the adr.call statement so Command performs no external call and forwards no funds.
Change the guard from >= to > so the transfer also happens when msg.value equals the contract balance exactly, instead of being skipped in that case.
Transfer only the contract's prior balance instead of balance plus msg.value, changing the amount sent out on success.
